modelIdentification.name: PitchTalk Effects
modelIdentification.purpose: Provide interoperability in the Audio and Chat domain
modelIdentification.description: The Pitch Talk Effects FOM provides a way to model effects for the Pitch Talk framework

objectClass.name: ChannelEffectState
objectClass.semantics:
Describes the state of the enabled Effect Plugin for a channel as a set of parameters of different data types. Each client should respond by configuring the channel's Effect Plugin accordingly.
If there are no parameters of a given data type, the corresponding attribute should not have a value.
Several objects of this class may exist for the same channel at once, but if so, they may not set the same parameter.

attribute.name: ChannelUUID
attribute.semantics: The UUID of the affected channel.

attribute.name: LongParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with integer values.

attribute.name: DoubleParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with double values.

attribute.name: StringParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with string values.

objectClass.name: UserEffectState
objectClass.semantics:
Describes the state of the enabled Effect Plugin on a channel for the communication between two specific users. Each client representing the receiving user should respond by configuring the channel's Effect Plugin accordingly.
Several objects of this class may exist at once for the same channel but different user pairs.
Several objects of this class may exist at once for the same channel and same user pair, but if so, they may not set the same parameter.
See also the semantics for ChannelEffectState.

attribute.name: ReceivingUser
attribute.semantics:
Name of the receiving user.
Note that this is not the same as the Client ID. The user name is set in the project configuration.
It is possible for multiple clients to represent the same user, in which case they will all respond to the same effect state.

attribute.name: SendingUser
attribute.semantics:
Name of the sending user.
Note that this is not the same as the Client ID. The user name is set in the project configuration.

objectClass.name: EffectPluginDefinition
objectClass.semantics:
Instructs Pitch Talk clients which Effect Plugin to use for a channel.
Clients can only enable one plugin at a time, so only one distinct object of this class may exists for each channel at any one time.

attribute.name: ChannelUUID
attribute.semantics: The UUID of the channel

attribute.name: EffectPluginIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The Java class name of the requested Effect Plugin.

objectClass.name: EffectModelDefinition
objectClass.semantics:
This object will be registered by the Admin Server according to the project configuration.
An Effect Modelling Federate recognizing the named Effect Model should respond by activating the Effect Model for the specified channel.

attribute.name: ChannelUUID
attribute.semantics: The UUID of the affected channel.

attribute.name: EffectModelIdentifier
attribute.semantics: An identifying string for the requested Effect Model.

attribute.name: ChannelUUIDs
attribute.semantics: The list of UUIDs of the affected channels.

objectClass.name: ChannelEffectState
objectClass.semantics:
Describes the state of the enabled Effect Plugin on specified channel(s), as a set of parameters of different datatypes, for the communication between all clients.
Several objects of this class may exist for the same channel at once, but if so, they may not set the same parameter.

attribute.name: LongParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with integer values.

attribute.name: DoubleParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with double values.

attribute.name: StringParameters
attribute.semantics: Parameters with string values.

objectClass.name: EquipmentEffectState
objectClass.semantics:
Describes the states of the enabled Effect Plugin on specified channel(s) for the communication between one receiving and multiple sending equipment.
Several objects of this class may exist at once, for the same channel(s) and receiving equipment and sending equipment, but if so, they may not set the same parameter.
The SendParametersBase and SendParametersDelta attributes work together to represent the full sending equipment parameters. The SendParametersBase attribute will initialize the base data and update all parameters while the SendParametersDelta will override the base data with updated values only so we avoid sending all the base data when only few parameters need to be added/updated/removed. When applying the SendParametersDelta changes to the SendParametersBase data, the SendParametersDelta will need to be wiped away waiting for new parameter(s) updates.

attribute.name: ReceivingEquipmentUUID
attribute.semantics: Reference to receiving equipment.

attribute.name: SendParametersBase
attribute.semantics:
Base data containing all parameters for multiple sending equipment.
These parameters are aggregated into this big array for performance reasons, because sending each parameter set in its own attribute ends up creating too many attributes to effectively handle.
Parameters may be overridden by the SendParametersDelta attribute.

attribute.name: SendParametersDelta
attribute.semantics:
Delta data containing added/updated/removed parameters relative to the SendParametersBase attribute. These parameters will in other words override parameters set in the SendParametersBase attribute.
The objective of this delta attribute is to improve performance when changing a few parameters. Since the base data is potentially very large, we want to avoid sending all of it when for example just updating one parameter. This means that the delta will keep growing if we keep changing different parameters. Eventually it might become too large and contain many parameters that have not changed for many updates of this attribute. At this point we can reset the data which means that we update the base data to the latest parameters and clear the delta data.

arrayData.name: LongParameterArray
arrayData.semantics: An array of parameters with integer values.

arrayData.name: DoubleParameterArray
arrayData.semantics: An array of parameters with double values.

arrayData.name: StringParameterArray
arrayData.semantics: An array of parameters with string values.

arrayData.name: SendingEqParamsArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters sets which apply between the sending equipment specified in this array and a receiving equipment specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender shall only appear once in the array.

arrayData.name: SendingUserParamsArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters sets which apply between the sending users specified in this array and a receiving user specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender shall only appear once in the array.

arrayData.name: SendingUserEqParamsArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters sets which apply between the sending users and equipment pairs specified in this array and a receiving user and equipment pair specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender (user and equipment combination) shall only appear once in the array.

arrayData.name: SendingUserEqParamsDeltaArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters delta sets which apply between the sending users and equipment pairs specified in this array and a receiving user and equipment pair specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender (user and equipment combination) shall only appear once in the array.

arrayData.name: SendingUserParamsDeltaArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters delta sets which apply between the sending users specified in this array and a receiving user specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender shall only appear once in the array.

arrayData.name: SendingEqParamsDeltaArray
arrayData.semantics:
Multiple parameters delta sets which apply between the sending equipment specified in this array and a receiving equipment specified by the effect state containing this array.
Elements referencing a specific sender shall only appear once in the array.

fixedRecordData.name: SendingEqParams
fixedRecordData.semantics:
Parameters which apply between the sending equipment specified by this fixed record and a receiving equipment specified by the effect state containing these parameters.
Several double, long or string parameters may exist for the same channel at once, but if so, they may not set the same parameter key or not the same sending equipment.

fixedRecordData.semantics:

Several double, long or string parameters may exist for the same channel at once, but if so, they may not set the same parameter key or not the same sending user and equipment pair.

fixedRecordData.semantics:

Several double, long or string parameters may exist for the same channel at once, but if so, they may not set the same parameter key or not the same sending user and equipment pair.
